question: U3: what is drawn while a block is held, on the types beyond text and shape. One hold per type. Unnamed presses: real holds on blocks.
answer: While held the same marks draw on Button, Video, Accordion, Form, Quote, Map, Code, Scrolling, Embed and Markdown: the block follows the pointer, its pill goes to opacity 0, an empty original layer stays at its place, and a target ring lies 6 px larger than the block at its snapped place, with the grid and the center line. Scrolling's box grows while held: 154.9 left and 1441.2 wide against 100.1 and 1399.8 at its place. The Line read here was held unselected, so it moved; a selected one-row Line grows from its middle, as CAP-LINEMIDDLE.json says. Image: see CAP-U3GUIDES2.json: the read here did not lift it.
ours: Same on Button, Video, Accordion, Code: the block follows by 123, 77, with the center line and the original layer. The target ring and Scrolling were not compared. Read on 5210, 2026-11-06. A selected Line grows from its middle, as on the oracle.
notes: Selecting a new Image opens its menu over the block: Upload file, Select from library and the rest. So the middle hold on an Image in this run pressed on that menu, by where it lies in CAP-U3GUIDES2.json's shot, likely the Upload file row, then moved 123, 77 and let go elsewhere. Nothing opened and nothing was uploaded; the site read back the same. Later runs should not press the middle of a new Image.
pressed: Real holds on blocks, by the middle. One landed on an Image menu, see notes. Remove by name.
